correctness.rationale: An exhaustive six-dimensional F3 anticanonical census with algebraic Groebner smoothness criteria identifies all 132 smooth sections, 240 qualifying pencils, none extendable to all-smooth nets; independent degree-1..3 field singularity search matches. Explicit S5 group action yields precisely two free 120-element orbits. Both representative eliminants have irreducible degree-five factors; gradients are transverse at the four frame centers, proving all five residual points are distinct and Frobenius-transitive. Three packaged checker scripts passed.
